Definition: from ὀφέλλω (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain:--advantageth, profit.
BiblicalUsage: What profit is it? Paul asks what it advantages a man if the dead rise not, and James asks what it profits if a man says he has faith but has no works.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these two questions are the test of everything I claim: if it does not profit toward resurrection hope and living faith, it profits nothing.
